name: 関連情報を含むデータベース行
prompt:
Use case: UI component redesign
ONE static Japanese Lighthouse relational database row LH09-0042. ORIGINAL images1–2 control every icon silhouette, photo appearance, optical/stroke weight, column proportions, spacing, alignment and state. Mock3 supplies Japanese adapted wording/date only; DO NOT copy its generic arrows, mint avatar or green Not-Started dot.
Very wide shallow white table row1105x34 logical pixels. Six columns with widths271,145,161,160,193,175. Fine neutral top/bottom and vertical cell rules, pure #FFFFFF canvas/cells, no tinted panels/raised card. All contents vertically centered with8px left padding.
Cell1: underlined task link「担当者を招待する」, Meiryo Regular14/24 near-black, thin source underline.
Cell2: small WHITE rounded status pill, fine neutral border, original tiny NEUTRAL GRAY circular dot +「未着手」Regular12/16. Preserve Not-Started meaning; no green completed dot or selected state.
Cell3: ORIGINAL source photo avatar appearance of Jane, small20px circular crop, then Japanese name「山田 花子」Regular14/24. No mint/initial substitute.
Cell4: exact Japanese adapted date「2026年4月15日」Regular14/24, as Japanese mock.
Cell5: ORIGINAL tiny WALKING/RUNNING PERSON glyph with its source forward-leaning posture/arm/leg details (not a northeast arrow), then underlined related sprint「準備期間 3」. Preserve small silhouette and source thin optical weight.
Cell6: ORIGINAL thin CIRCLE enclosing right-pointing ARROW, then underlined related project「礼拝の準備」. The full original group header confirms the project relation context despite cropped original row text; use Japanese project wording supplied by mock. Do not use a bare northeast arrow.
Supporting glyphs #526173, neutral status dot gray. Preserve source linked-text treatment, small photo and compact6-column density. Meiryo regular, metadata12/16, body14/24, zero tracking, no bold. No header, extra rows, sidebar, cover artwork, watermark, labels, perspective, annotation or comparison board. All six cells fully visible; tight framing.
reviewNotes: 6列の日本語内容、未着手の灰色ドット、写真と原本の歩行人物／丸矢印の形を確認。丸矢印が指定スレートでなく原本青のまま、文字も指定Regularより重いので訂正。日本語の日付はモックの2026年4月15日に適応。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
